_doc: Which wago.tools builds are World of Warcraft: Forever. `pipeline client-check` picks the newest build whose product is listed in `products` OR whose version is 1.x at or above `min_version`, so a product key that moves (wow_classic_beta -> wow_cn_beta in October 2026) or a renumbering at launch is still found. Products in `ignore_products` are never Forever, whatever their version. A build newer than the active one that matches neither rule is reported as a warning, never activated. `blizzard_products` are the product codes asked at us.version.battle.net, Blizzard's own version service, which names a new client the hour it ships; wago.tools exports its tables later (a day or more), and the fetch needs those exports, so the watcher reports the gap and waits.
_test_product_pattern: A product key this regex matches is a PTR or test realm and is never Forever live, whatever its version (a Forever PTR is numbered 1.6x and newer than live); it is not warned about either. `products` may not match it. Hand-dispatch client.yml with build= and product= to move to such a build deliberately.
